_comment: MCP server configuration template for GitHub Copilot (VS Code extension).
TARGET SURFACE: VS Code only. This file is a stub/template.
The live MCP config for VS Code belongs in .vscode/mcp.json (workspace-scoped)
or in the VS Code user settings under 'mcp.servers'.
- Only 'tools' transport is supported (no resources, no prompts).
- No OAuth remote MCP — stdio or http+sse only.
- For cloud agents: secrets must be prefixed COPILOT_MCP_ in the 'copilot' environment.
- MCP servers can also be declared per-agent in .github/agents/<name>.agent.md frontmatter
To activate: copy or symlink the relevant server block into .vscode/mcp.json.
